blindReviewDeclaration: This fresh independent reviewer formed the findings and NO_GO verdict from checklist-bound owning sources before reading any author self-assessment, disposition, or Claude handoff; none of those author materials were read.
expectedBehavior: P6-1 freezes only contract, owner, edge, additive-data and generated-consumer inputs, proves owner/controller unit behavior before its phase review, and does not implement a UI page.
P6-2 starts only after P6-1 Dexter and Claude implementation GO; P6-3 starts only after the corresponding P6-2 GO.

All 22 carry-over surfaces and 25 pageDesignKeys have delivery-unit assignment, accepted IA anchor, generated operation or exact N/A reason, failure/recovery, and exact CARRY/ADAPT/NOT_CARRIED disposition.
Every UI-bearing screen has exact current-to-final paths and an explicit admin-ui-foundation primitive or concrete NONE_WITH_REASON, enabling import equality and its red mutations.

Owner readback, candidate selection, command authorization, generation, six source-compliance denominators, non-empty incremental receipts, and forbidden pseudo-fixes remain independently testable at package exit.

findings.title: The manifest cannot close the seven non-catalog surface denominator across the three delivery units.
findings.evidence: No delivery unit has uiAndTerms.nonCatalogSurfaces; its lists contain only 8 platform and 17 operations/home pageDesignKeys. frontend-asset-carryover-manifest.json#pageDesignKeySurfaceCrosswalk names seven additional surfaces: PLATFORM-AUTH, PLATFORM-PASSWORD, OPERATIONS-AUTH, PUBLIC-INVITATION, PUBLIC-ACCESS-RECOVERY, OPERATIONS-SHELL and OPERATIONS-PASSWORD. P6 preparation #5 D5 requires all 22 surfaces and 25 keys to carry exact CARRY/ADAPT/NOT_CARRIED reasoning and accepted IA hash/anchor; its #10 assigns these seven across P6-1/P6-2/P6-3. The reviewed manifest contains no unit-level IA anchor, generated operation/N-A, failure/recovery or receipt binding for them.
findings.risk: A phase can claim its generic OWNED_SURFACE_AND_PAGE_KEYS denominator while omitting an unauthenticated, shell, or Drawer behavior. This leaves self-service recovery, operations branding, invitation no-session behavior, and password-session revocation unprotected because no catalog page key can infer them.
findings.disposition: NO_GO until the manifest adds exact non-catalog assignments: U01 for PLATFORM-AUTH, OPERATIONS-AUTH and PUBLIC-ACCESS-RECOVERY contract/owner inputs; U02 for PLATFORM-PASSWORD; U03 for PUBLIC-INVITATION, OPERATIONS-SHELL and OPERATIONS-PASSWORD. Each needs IA anchor, exact implementation/retained path, operation/N-A, failure/recovery, applicable foundation declaration, focused proof and D5 assertion. This is smaller than changing the three-stage sequence or adding UI to P6-1.

findings.title: UI-bearing units cite page keys but omit the required screen-level final design and foundation-import contract.
findings.evidence: P6 preparation #4/#4.1 makes final admission fail closed unless each U09 row declares exact current-to-final paths, owner, prerequisite source/hash, interaction anchor, operation/N-A, failure/recovery, test contract, incremental verification and package-exit assertion; each UI screen must declare face, surface, host/entry, actor, scenario, goal, visible copy, technical boundary and FOUNDATION_PRIMITIVE or concrete NONE_WITH_REASON. U02/U03 only provide broad directories, pageKey-to-IA anchors and prose 'using admin-ui-foundation'. frontend-asset-carryover-manifest.json#foundationConsumptionBySurface is the counterexample: primitive requirements differ by surface, so that prose cannot supply the required import contract.
findings.risk: The promised frontend-architecture declaration/import equality cannot be implemented honestly; later code would guess Drawer, detail, lifecycle, context, overlay or protocol applicability, reopening duplicate-foundation and wrong-surface failures.
findings.disposition: NO_GO until U02/U03 materialize a screen/surface roster from accepted IA sheets, bind every FOUNDATION_PRIMITIVE to an exact final implementation path or unique same-surface shared owner, and add the two prescribed import-equality red mutations. Do not create new screens or duplicate UI behavior.

findings.title: U01's declared D1 owning source set is not equal to its six-dimension route result.
findings.evidence: A fresh `scripts/check/implementation-design-granularity --manifest ...rm1-u09-implementation-design-granularity-manifest.json --review ...round1.json` fails `D1_ROUTED_SOURCE_SET_MISMATCH:RM1P6-U01`. The checker derives the expected set from project-memory/index.json using U01's design/backend/all/backend/contract/implementation route. It includes project-memory/decisions/deterministic-context-only.md and project-memory/decisions/independent-subagent-adversarial-review.md in addition to U01's eight declared kernel/corpus entries, while U01's D1 owningSourceSet omits both.
findings.risk: The implementation-facing manifest cannot pass its own fail-closed six-denominator gate, and the omitted deterministic-context and independent-review assertions are not optional for this route.
findings.disposition: NO_GO until U01's D1 owningSourceSet is reconciled exactly to the route-derived project-memory/index.json set, including path, current hash and Assertions selector; rerun the production granularity check after remediation. This is a bounded denominator correction, not a reason to weaken D1.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The owner-first three-phase direction fits the accepted business problem: anonymous recovery and workspace branding need owner truth before rendering, and operations scope/candidate/authorization cannot be reconstructed from page keys.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Retain the three phases and extend the existing manifest with the missing seven assignments and screen-level foundation/path records. Treating generic directories or catalog keys as their substitute loses non-catalog user tasks.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Postponing UI until owner behavior is proved is proportionate. The missing records are bounded design work derivable from accepted IA sheets; without them material UI and evidence choices are transferred into coding, so current cost/benefit is not yet acceptable.

conclusion.summary: Round 1 independently confirms the owner-first serial direction and 25 catalog-key partition, but finds three blocking omissions: seven non-catalog surfaces lack delivery-unit manifest binding, UI-bearing units lack screen-level exact path/foundation-import contracts, and U01's D1 route set fails exact equality. M=3, S=0, N=0; no implementation conclusion follows.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: Static independent DESIGN verdict only. It authorizes no source, contract, migration, test, runtime, seed/reset, Roadmap, or repository-control changes. The author may do bounded design remediation and seek permitted Round 2 review; product/Journey changes remain Dexter decisions.
